# egrid_from_atoms_rust { #mofography.rust_fun.egrid_from_atoms_rust }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> Single-channel Rust energy grid; superseded for screening by tricubic 8-channel build.

```python
rust_fun.egrid_from_atoms_rust(
    ase_atoms,
    spacing,
    forcefield_mixed=None,
    cutoff=12.5,
    probe_symbol='He',
    return_ncells=False,
)
```

Compute an energy grid from atomic positions using the Rust backend.

This function calculates the energy field (egrid) for a given atomic structure,
where each grid point represents the Lennard-Jones interaction energy with
the framework atoms, using a probe molecule.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type                  | Description                                                                   | Default    |
|------------------|-----------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| ase_atoms        | ase.Atoms             | ASE Atoms object containing the atomic structure                              | _required_ |
| spacing          | float                 | Grid spacing in Angstroms                                                     | _required_ |
| forcefield_mixed | numpy.ndarray \| None | Mixed forcefield parameters. If None, computed using Lorentz-Berthelot mixing | `None`     |
| cutoff           | float                 | Cutoff distance for energy calculations in Angstroms                          | `12.5`     |
| probe_symbol     | str                   | Chemical symbol of the probe molecule                                         | `'He'`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type          | Description                                                |
|--------|---------------|------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | numpy.ndarray | 3D energy grid where values represent interaction energies |
